exact-apppath.note: quiet window; W3 exact final source

exact-cold.note: quiet window; W1 baseline vs exact final source

final-underload.note: final one-worker source after decisions; all samples under unrelated Godot load (flagged contaminated; functional check only)

final4.note: final one-worker source after decisions; discarded: overlapped Godot bursts up to 5.9 cores

nocap-apppath.note: quiet window; W3 capped final vs no CPU cap, with main-actor heartbeat, per-second CPU and thermal state

nocap-cold.note: quiet window; user decision 2026-10-24: W1 capped final vs no CPU cap

nocap-reopen.note: quiet window; W4 direct reopens capped final vs no CPU cap

par-cold.note: worker sweep 1/2/4/8/10, W1, back-to-back (thermal state partly fair; not used for decision)

par-sbx.note: worker sweep, W3 sandboxed cold, back-to-back (thermal state fair; not used for decision)

par-unsbx.note: worker sweep, W3 unsandboxed cold+reopen, back-to-back (thermal state fair; not used for decision)

quiet-apppath.note: quiet window; W3 catalog path (sandboxed cold only)

quiet-cold.note: quiet window; W1 baseline vs final before C6

sbx-work2.note: shared-machine window; W2 sandboxed vs unsandboxed

work-c1.note: shared-machine window; unthrottled W2; baseline vs C1

work-c2.note: shared-machine window; unthrottled W2; C1 vs C2
